title: Garage setback from a right-of-way
text: C3.3.5 Garages and carports are set back from a secondary street and right-of way in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a, adjoining laneway or right-of-way, where it is not the primary street to the dwelling: R10 and R12.5 As per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25 to R50-60 0.5m.

replaces.note: R10-R25 nil setback to a ROW or communal street with 6 m manoeuvring -> 0.5 m at R15+ (C4P1-083)

verified.note: 'right-of way' printed without the second hyphen. C3.3.5 does not say which laneway row applies; the 'not the primary street' row is used.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.5#garage-row. Uses the 'not the primary street' laneway row (R10 3 m, R12.5 2 m, R15-R60 0.5 m); where the ROW is the primary street the garage is governed by C3.3.3. Communal streets are not mentioned in C3.3.5 (C4P1-083).
